groups.note: सुप् carried from 2.1.2/2.1.4 into samāsa-vidhi rules is read as सुबन्त — Bālamanoramā on 2.1.4 cites pratyaya-grahaṇa explicitly. Formally samāsa rules are saṃjñā rules (PIS 27), but no commentator raises that here. Exceptions: rules that form no compound (adhikāra, nipātana lists, pūrvanipāta, gender), the द्वितीया that does not connect with avyayas (2.1.25/27), and the upapada/gati split (2.2.18–22). Also: in many samāsa rules a second suffix word (क्तेन, निष्ठा, पञ्चम्या, षष्ठ्या …) is read tadanta but not credited (see missed).
